name: Introduction to Rocket Propulsion
description: Basic principles of rocket propulsion and rocket engines.

lessons.name: History of Rocketry
lessons.description: A brief history of rocketry and space exploration.

lessons.name: Rocket Propulsion Fundamentals
lessons.description: Basic principles of rocket propulsion.

lessons.name: Rocket Engine Types
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket engines.

lessons.name: Propellant Types
lessons.description: Introduction to various rocket propellant types and their uses.

name: Fuel and Combustion
description: Understanding rocket fuel, combustion processes, and efficiency.

lessons.name: Rocket Fuel
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket fuels.

lessons.name: Combustion Processes
lessons.description: Understanding combustion processes and efficiency.

lessons.name: Combustion Instability
lessons.description: Understanding combustion instability and mitigation.

lessons.name: Oxidizers in Rocket Engines
lessons.description: Understanding the role of oxidizers and their types in rocket engines.

name: Nozzle Design
description: Principles of rocket nozzle design and performance optimization.

lessons.name: Nozzle Design
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket nozzles.

lessons.name: Nozzle Performance
lessons.description: Understanding nozzle performance and efficiency.

lessons.name: Nozzle Optimization
lessons.description: Optimizing nozzle design for specific applications.

lessons.name: 3D Printing of Nozzles
lessons.description: Exploring the use of 3D printing technology in the manufacturing of rocket nozzles.

name: Rocket Propulsion Testing
description: Methods and procedures for testing rocket propulsion systems.

lessons.name: Static Fire Testing
lessons.description: Overview of static fire testing methods and data collection.

lessons.name: Thrust Measurement
lessons.description: Understanding thrust measurement techniques in propulsion systems.

lessons.name: Failure Analysis
lessons.description: Procedures for analyzing and mitigating propulsion system failures.

name: Fundamentals of Aerodynamics
description: Basic aerodynamic concepts and fluid dynamics principles.

lessons.name: Introduction to Fluid Dynamics
lessons.description: Understanding the fundamental principles of fluid dynamics in aerodynamics.

lessons.name: Aerodynamic Forces
lessons.description: An overview of the forces acting on a rocket during flight.

name: Subsonic and Supersonic Flow
description: Understanding subsonic and supersonic aerodynamic behaviors.

lessons.name: Subsonic Flow Characteristics
lessons.description: Overview of the behavior of subsonic flow over a body.

lessons.name: Supersonic Flow Characteristics
lessons.description: Overview of the behavior of supersonic flow over a body.

lessons.name: Shock Waves and Expansion Fans
lessons.description: Study of shock waves and expansion fans in supersonic flows.

name: Aerodynamic Heating
description: Study of aerodynamic heating and thermal protection systems.

lessons.name: Thermal Protection Systems
lessons.description: Introduction to the design and materials used in thermal protection systems.

lessons.name: Heat Transfer in Aerospace
lessons.description: Understanding heat transfer mechanisms in aerospace applications.

name: Spacecraft Structural Design
description: Fundamentals of designing spacecraft structures and materials selection.

lessons.name: Lightweight Materials
lessons.description: Introduction to the materials used for lightweight spacecraft structures.

lessons.name: Structural Integrity Testing
lessons.description: Methods for testing the structural integrity of spacecraft.

name: Orbital Mechanics
description: Understanding orbital dynamics and mission planning.

lessons.name: Kepler's Laws
lessons.description: Overview of Kepler's laws and their application in orbital mechanics.

lessons.name: Orbital Maneuvers
lessons.description: Introduction to orbital maneuvers, including Hohmann transfers and plane changes.

name: Spacecraft Systems Engineering
description: Overview of spacecraft systems and subsystems engineering.

lessons.name: Subsystem Integration
lessons.description: Understanding how spacecraft subsystems are integrated into a complete system.

lessons.name: Telemetry and Communication
lessons.description: Overview of telemetry systems and spacecraft communication protocols.

name: Functional Groups
description: Understanding the structure, properties, and reactions of different functional groups.

lessons.name: Alcohols and Ethers
lessons.description: Study of the structure, properties, and reactions of alcohols (R-OH) and ethers (R-O-R').

lessons.name: Carbonyl Compounds
lessons.description: Covers functional groups like aldehydes (R-CHO) and ketones (R-CO-R'), focusing on their reactivity in nucleophilic addition reactions.

name: Coordination Compounds
description: Study of metal complexes where metal ions are bonded to ligands, focusing on their structure, bonding, and reactivity.

lessons.name: Ligand Field Theory
lessons.description: Explores how ligands affect the energy levels of a central metal ion and influence properties like magnetism, color, and stability of the complex.

lessons.name: Chelation
lessons.description: Involves ligands that form multiple bonds with a central metal ion, creating more stable complexes known as chelates, commonly seen in biological and industrial processes.

name: Thermodynamics
description: Study of energy changes in chemical reactions, focusing on concepts like enthalpy, entropy, and Gibbs free energy.

lessons.name: Enthalpy and Heat Transfer
lessons.description: Focuses on heat exchange during chemical reactions and phase changes, with an emphasis on enthalpy changes (ΔH) and their role in determining reaction energy.

lessons.name: Laws of Thermodynamics
lessons.description: Covers the fundamental principles governing energy transfer, including the first law (conservation of energy) and the second law (entropy and spontaneity).

name: Tengwar Script
description: Overview of Tengwar which is an Elvish script used to write Quenya, Sindarin, and other languages in Middle-earth.

lessons.name: Tengwar Letters and Phonetics
lessons.description: Study of how the Tengwar symbols represent consonants, vowels, and diacritical marks to form words and sounds in different languages.

lessons.name: Modes of Writing
lessons.description: Exploration of the various writing modes, such as the Quenya mode and Sindarin mode, where the script adapts to different phonetic rules for each language.
